note: Attic room of the rarer, more formal prepositions (malgré, hors, via, moyennant, hormis, excepté...). Prepositions have no gender, so no left/right rule (divider null). The white door on the far left goes back to the third pronouns room; this is the end of the school walk. The attic has no wall board, so the room name sits on the plain back wall.
